answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities: a new identity pays a sunk 50-credit tax, never refunded. Like a prism splitting one beam, one tax buys one identity — each extra identity needs another tax. An honest agent anchors itself with one payment, while a dune of unpaid clones collapses under audit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5000 credits, above fraud gains. An honest agent pays once, its tax falling to 5 after 20 epochs, keeping rewards undiluted.
